label: 5. Have you ever heard of Qi

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Have you ever heard of Qi

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: by any chance?
I think so, but remind me.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Well, depending on how you use it, it can be utilized in boxing.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I found out a couple days ago

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: that if you harness your Qi properly,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: you can send your opponents flying backwards without even touching them.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: You can even attack them from a distance.
Where is this going?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: If you've got enough control over your Qi,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: you can condense it into propulsive bursts of air

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: that can act as bullets.
That can't be true.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Well, if it is,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: then traditional firearms would be obsolete.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Gone would be the days of worrying about running out of bullets or reloading.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: And the more you trained, the stronger you'd become.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: train with me!
You've been reading a bunch of martial arts novels lately, haven't you?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: How'd you know?
These kinds of skills only exist in novels.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Bummer...

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Fine, I'll just do my regular workout.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Fancy a sparring match?
You're on.
